items.title: Bitcoin holds near $63K as crypto market stays range-bound
items.summary: Bitcoin traded around $63,000 to $63,500 over the past day, with multiple market reports showing only small 24-hour moves while traders waited for clearer macro and regulatory signals. Ethereum, XRP, Solana, and Dogecoin were mixed, underscoring a generally cautious crypto market.

items.title: Binance to restrict transfers involving HTX and 10 other platforms for UK and EU users
items.summary: Binance said it will restrict transactions involving HTX and 10 other crypto platforms for users in the UK and European Union starting August 23. The move is one of the clearest regulatory/compliance-related developments in the latest news flow.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF flows and institutional positioning remain in focus
items.summary: Reports noted renewed spot Bitcoin ETF withdrawals, while another market update said UBS increased call-option exposure tied to BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust more than 24-fold in Q2. Together, those items suggest active institutional repositioning even as prices remain subdued.

items.title: Bitcoin and major altcoins post only modest 24-hour changes
items.summary: Recent price snapshots showed Bitcoin up about 0.1% to 0.7%, Ethereum roughly flat to slightly higher, XRP near $1 with small declines, and Solana and Dogecoin moving modestly. The broader takeaway is that major coins are not seeing a decisive breakout in either direction.

items.title: DefiLlama delays mobile launch over phishing-app concerns
items.summary: DefiLlama said it delayed its mobile app launch after concerns about phishing apps on the Apple App Store. The incident highlights continuing security and distribution challenges for crypto projects on mainstream mobile platforms.

items.title: Apple patches macOS flaw used to mine Monero
items.summary: Crypto.news reported that Apple patched a macOS vulnerability that was being exploited to mine Monero. The story is notable because it links a mainstream software security issue to illicit crypto mining activity.

items.title: XRP-related product activity stays active despite weak price action
items.summary: News flow showed XRP-focused exchange-traded funds attracting $27.29 million in July, extending a four-month inflow streak, while another item said XRP holders can now trade options on Derive using FXRP as collateral. These developments point to continued product expansion around XRP.

items.title: U.S. sanctions Iranian maritime scheme that allegedly demanded Bitcoin tolls
items.summary: The United States imposed sanctions on an Iranian maritime operation accused of forcing commercial vessels to pay Bitcoin ransoms for safe passage. This is the most direct sanctions-related crypto news in the latest set of reports.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: VGC reports August PS Plus Game Catalog additions and new Xbox controller reveal
items.summary: Sony’s August PlayStation Plus Game Catalog includes Helldivers 2, Vampire Survivors, and Kingdom Come Deliverance 2, while Xbox has officially revealed a limited edition Gears of War E-Day controller with new Design Lab options. Both items are notable platform news for players and collectors.

items.title: Amazon exits MMO operations for Lost Ark and Throne & Liberty
items.summary: Amazon Game Studios is handing operational duties for Lost Ark and Throne & Liberty back to their developers, ending Amazon’s direct MMO publishing presence. The move marks a significant restructuring in the live-service PC game space.

items.title: Ghost of Yotei gets story expansion, roguelike mode, and Complete Edition details
items.summary: Sony-related coverage highlights a new story expansion and roguelike mode for Ghost of Yotei, arriving in October alongside a Complete Edition. The expansion, Echoes of Sekigahara, and the Most Wanted mode are listed at $14.99.

items.title: Phantom Blade Zero shows new footage and teases State of Play appearance
items.summary: Phantom Blade Zero has received an 11-minute trailer, and a PlayStation State of Play is expected next week. The update also confirms martial arts star Donnie Yen will appear in the game.

items.title: PlayStation reveals limited edition Wolverine PS5 hardware
items.summary: PlayStation has unveiled a limited edition Wolverine-themed PS5 console, along with matching controllers and console covers. The announcement adds to the wave of themed hardware tied to major first-party releases.

items.title: Fortnite confirms Sonic crossover for next season
items.summary: Fortnite has confirmed that Sonic will arrive in its next season, called Override. The crossover continues Epic’s strategy of adding major entertainment brands to the game.

items.title: Xbox says major outage issue has been fixed
items.summary: Xbox CTO says the issue behind last month’s major outage has now been resolved. That makes this a notable platform operations update for online players and subscribers.

items.title: Supermassive Games reportedly laying off up to 75 staff
items.summary: The Dark Pictures Anthology studio Supermassive Games is laying off as many as 75 employees to 'ensure sustainability.' It is another sign of ongoing industry-wide restructuring and cost-cutting.

items.title: Senate subcommittee opens Roblox child safety investigation
items.summary: A U.S. Senate subcommittee has opened an investigation into Roblox over child safety concerns, citing allegations that the platform prioritizes revenue and engagement over child welfare. This is one of the most significant industry and policy stories in gaming coverage this week.

items.title: Netflix closes two game studios, including Night School Studio
items.summary: Netflix is shutting down two game studios, including Night School Studio despite praise for Unhinged. The move underscores the company’s continuing retrenchment in game development.
